levels.surface: سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: «أَخِيهِ نُوحٍ» (his brother Nuh) is written as the name alone (rule 7); «وَ غَيْرِهِ» (and others) is an unnamed co-transmitter of «علي بن الحكم»
«جَمِيعاً» joins the three names of the second level at «أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى»; the last link «علي» follows «عن», so narrator; the saying is his report of the Prophet
